tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and leukocyte esterase, as well as >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in culture. Presence of blood and protein is likely secondary to infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
